description: This module manages compute instances on Scaleway.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: Scaleway API URL. Default: "https://api.scaleway.com"

parameters.name: commercial_type
parameters.description: Commercial name of the compute node.

parameters.name: enable_ipv6
parameters.description: Enable public IPv6 connectivity on the instance. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Image identifier used to start the instance with.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the instance.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Organization identifier. Exactly one of project and organization must be specified.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project identifier. Exactly one of project and organization must be specified.

parameters.name: public_ip
parameters.description: Manage public IP on a Scaleway server. Could be Scaleway IP address UUID. dynamic Means that IP is destroyed at the same time the host is destroyed. absent Means no public IP at all. Default: "absent"

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway compute zone. Choices: "ams1" "EMEA-NL-EVS" "ams2" "ams3" "par1" "EMEA-FR-PAR1" "par2" "EMEA-FR-PAR2" "par3" "waw1" "EMEA-PL-WAW1" "waw2" "waw3"

parameters.name: security_group
parameters.description: Security group unique identifier. If no value provided, the default security group or current security group is used.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the instance. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "running" "restarted" "stopped"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: List of tags to apply to the instance (5 max). Default: []

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the instance to reach its desired state before returning. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: wait_sleep_time
parameters.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the server. Default: 3

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Time to wait for the server to reach the expected state. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Create a server
  community.general.scaleway_compute:
    name: foobar
    state: present
    image: 89ee4018-f8c3-4dc4-a6b5-bca14f985ebe
    project: 951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42
    region: ams1
    commercial_type: VC1S
    tags:
      - test
      - www

- name: Create a server attached to a security group
  community.general.scaleway_compute:
    name: foobar
    state: present
    image: 89ee4018-f8c3-4dc4-a6b5-bca14f985ebe
    project: 951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42
    region: ams1
    commercial_type: VC1S
    security_group: 4a31b633-118e-4900-bd52-facf1085fc8d
    tags:
      - test
      - www

- name: Destroy it right after
  community.general.scaleway_compute:
    name: foobar
    state: absent
    image: 89ee4018-f8c3-4dc4-a6b5-bca14f985ebe
    project: 951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42
    region: ams1
    commercial_type: VC1S
